    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

concurrency:
  group: home-latest-update

jobs:
  update-youtube-latest:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"

      - name: Setup pinned WebP codecs
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-home-webp

      - name: Collect and validate isolated updates
        id: collect
        env:
          YOUTUBE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.YOUTUBE_API_KEY }}
          YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID: ${{ vars.YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID || 'UCdnf6zMzSdZuvUxS-CS2REQ' }}
